description:
Imports Create. Import a CSV in the export's format, a CSV with other column names through `mapping`, or an
`md-bundle` zip (base64 in `bundle`). A row with `key` edits that case and must carry the `version`
it was exported at; a row without one creates a case in `feature`. All or nothing: any bad row gives
422 with `errors: [{row, column, detail}]` (row 1 is the first after the header, or the first `.md`
file by name) and writes nothing. `dry_run` checks every row and returns the counts without writing;
that answer is not kept for an `Idempotency-Key` replay.

create_features.description: Create missing features named in the `feature` path

dry_run.description: Check every row and report the counts, but write nothing

name: imports_create

description:
Mcp Clients. Who called MCP tools over `since`..`until` (by default the last 24 hours, at most 90 days): per actor
(a member, `user`, or an AI agent, `agent`) its calls, errors and the latest UTC hour with a call, most
calls first. A token acts as its actor, so calls made with it are counted there.

since.description: From this time, inclusive; truncated to the hour (to the day for bucket=day)

until.description: Up to this time, exclusive; rounded up to the hour (to the day for bucket=day)

name: mcp_server_get

description:
Mcp Tools List. Every MCP tool with its definition cost in ≈ tokens (bytes ÷ 4), its calls and errors over the last 7
and 30 days, and its `calls`, `errors` and p50/p95 response cost (an upper bound, ≤2x; null with no calls)
over `since`..`until`: by default the last 30 days, at most 90.

since.description: From this time, inclusive; truncated to the hour (to the day for bucket=day)

until.description: Up to this time, exclusive; rounded up to the hour (to the day for bucket=day)

name: mcp_tools_list

description:
Mcp Updates. The MCP server's starts and tool-list changes, newest first. One row per start: `tools_changed` when
its tool list differs from the previous row's (naming the tools added, removed and changed), else
`server_started`. Server-wide: every org sees the same rows, which hold only tool names and versions.
name: mcp_updates

description:
Mcp Usage. MCP calls (split into `reads` and `writes`), errors and response bytes per hour or day (UTC), with
p50/p95 response cost in ≈ tokens (an upper bound, ≤2x). Only buckets with calls are listed. Defaults: the
last 24 hours by hour, or the last 30 days by day; at most 90 days. A read is a call to a tool the running
server marks read-only; every other call, including one to a tool it no longer serves, is a write.

since.description: From this time, inclusive; truncated to the hour (to the day for bucket=day)

until.description: Up to this time, exclusive; rounded up to the hour (to the day for bucket=day)

name: mcp_usage

description:
Plans Add Entries. Appends entries in order: `{case_id}` (a live case of the plan's product, by key like PAY-12 or id;
the entry stores the id), `{feature_id}` (an active feature of it), `{query}`, or `{release_id}` (a
release of the product).

A release expands now to one feature entry per feature of the release, in feature tree order, skipping
features the plan (or this request) already has and archived ones. The release id isn't stored, so a
later change to the release doesn't change the plan. Nothing new to add returns the plan unchanged.
